subject: Preventing freezing tables/plots that come from invalidate later and long calculation chains

messages.author: 28722f4922e8b1f3
messages.subject: Preventing freezing tables/plots that come from invalidate later and long calculation chains
parts:
Is there an option or work around in Shiny that can prevent the temporarily freezing/'white out' of tables and base R plots while calculations are being updated?

I would like to use shiny to update live time series plots and tables ideally every couple of seconds, but it is visually unappealing to see the plots and tables "freeze" temporarily while they wait for dependencies to compute that are time consuming (a second or two, for example).

One work around for plots I've found is to use ggvis for updating plots; they don't "Freeze"/'white out' while waiting for time consuming computations and just update, but I would like to use renderTable, renderDataTable and renderPlot, all which seem to have this freezing issue.

I would rather just see the plots/tables update once the calculations are completed with no freezing while waiting for the intermediate calculations.

Below is a minimal example that imitates the problem if you run the app:



library(shiny)

compute_seconds <- 1.5

server <- shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {

    values <- reactive({
        invalidateLater(input$delay * 1000, session)
        data <- mtcars[sample(1:20),]
        Sys.sleep(compute_seconds) # This sleep represents some intensive calculation that takes a few seconds to crunch through

        data
    })

    output$showtable <- renderTable({
        values()
    })

})

ui <- shinyUI(fluidPage(

    sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
            sliderInput("delay", "Delay (secs):",
                        min = 1, max = 30, value = 4, step = 0.5)
        ),

        mainPanel(
            h5("Don't want to see this table freeze/'white out' when output$showtable is invalidated and is waiting on a long computation"),
            tableOutput("showtable")
        )
    )
))

runApp(list(ui = ui, server = server))

--------------

messages.subject: Re: Preventing freezing tables/plots that come from invalidate later and long calculation chains
parts:
Solution:

Just after fluidPage in ui.R, adding this line:

tags$style(type="text/css",
        ".recalculating {opacity: 1.0;}"
    ),
